admin.demoUnlockLabel: Unlock all levels for every trainee
admin.demoUnlockHelp: For demonstrations only. Every authored level becomes selectable without passing the previous one. Scores, progress and 'passed' records are not changed. Turn it off to restore normal progression.
admin.demoUnlockOn: Demo mode on: all levels are unlocked.
admin.demoUnlockOff: Demo mode off: normal progression restored.

missions.demoUnlock: Demo mode is on: an administrator has unlocked all levels. Normal progression rules are paused; your results are still recorded as usual.
